units.source_text: 虽是歪诗，但源氏公子觉得也很有趣。

en.t: Though it was a clumsy poem, Prince Genji found it very amusing.

units.source_text: 这时候他对夕颜畅叙衷曲，毫无隐饰，

en.t: At this moment he spoke freely to Yugao of his inmost feelings, hiding nothing at all,

units.source_text: 其风采之优美，真是盖世无双，

en.t: and the elegance of his bearing was truly without equal in the world,

units.source_text: 和这环境对比之下，竟有乖戾之感。

en.t: so that, set against these surroundings, it even seemed strangely out of place.

units.source_text: 他对夕颜说：“你对我一向隐瞒，我很不快，

en.t: He said to Yugao, "You have always kept things hidden from me, and that has displeased me,

units.source_text: 所以也不把真面目给你看。

en.t: so I too did not show you my true face.

units.source_text: 现在我已经公开，你总可把姓名告诉我了。

en.t: Now that I have revealed myself, surely you can tell me your name.
If you keep going on like this, it leaves me quite troubled."

units.source_text: 夕颜答道：“我是个无家可归的流浪儿[\[22\]](#part1333.html#m22)！”

en.t: Yugao answered, "I am a wanderer with no home to return to[\[22\]](#part1333.html#m22)!"

units.source_text: 这尚未完全融洽的样子倒显得娇艳。

en.t: Her still not entirely relaxed manner seemed all the more charming and alluring.

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“这便无可奈何了！

en.t: Prince Genji said, "Then there is nothing to be done!

units.source_text: 原是我自己先做榜样的，怪你不得了。”

en.t: After all, I was the one who set the example first, so I cannot blame you."

units.source_text: 两人有时诉恨，有时谈情，度过了这一天。

en.t: The two of them spent the day sometimes airing their grievances and sometimes speaking tenderly of love.
